query: UPDATE solar_data_tsdb SET today_kwh = (raw_data -> 'data' -> 'kpi' ->> 'power')::float8, month_kwh = (raw_data -> 'data' -> 'kpi' ->> 'month_generation')::float8, total_kwh = (raw_data -> 'data' -> 'kpi' ->> 'total_power')::float8 WHERE time IN ( SELECT time FROM solar_data_tsdb WHERE today_kwh IS NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT $1 )
